node.title: Re: use of strict
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
You've already got answers to your questions, I just wanted to add: For some more info on [doc://strict] see also [id://111088]. And, in this case, you can parameterize the width of a [doc://sprintf] format without interpolating into the format string:

my $w = 5; my $str = "abc"; my $line = sprintf "%*s", $w, $str; print "<", $line, ">\n"; __END__ < abc>

Update: [Athanasius] beat me to it ;-)
